text:
omar: Heads-up — during a long-chat soak I see eviction counters flatlining while memory/residency keeps increasing. hit_rate looks steady (~92%) but tail memory grows. Grafana link: https://grafana.internal/r/kv-residency (private).

julia: Can you paste the queries/metrics you used? screenshot?

omar: PromQL I used to eyeball evictions vs samples:
```
sum(increase(kv_evictions_total[10m])) by (shard)
/
sum(increase(kv_residency_samples_total[10m])) by (shard)
```
Logs show some suspicious lines during the soak: `kvcache: shard=7 evict_attempt=1 evicted=0 reused=1 residency=0.34` — i.e. eviction attempted then reuse in same tick.

natalie: That pattern screams "coalesced evict/reuse" — sampler misses those as separate events so our eviction_total undercounts. We saw similar in a microbench last year but thought it was rare. Suggest adding a small counter `kv_eviction_coalesced_total` and tagging samples with `sampler_version`. Also expose `residency_age_bucket{le=\"...\"}` histogram so we can see age at eviction.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: kvcache/sampler-fix -> staging at 2026-03-18T09:30:00Z :package: (CI green)

sam: For dashboards: add these panels —
- residency p50/p90/p99 over time (by shard)
- coalesced_eviction ratio = coalesced / (evictions_total + coalesced)
- sample skew heatmap (session_length vs sampler_version)
Alert: coalesced_ratio > 0.05 for 10m -> page.
PromQL for ratio:
```
sum(increase(kv_eviction_coalesced_total[10m]))
/
sum(increase(kv_evictions_total[10m]) + increase(kv_eviction_coalesced_total[10m]))
```
ClickHouse-ish join idea to correlate by session_id:
```
SELECT
  session_id,
  anyHeavy(argMax(residency, ts)) as residency_last,
  sum(evicted) as evicted_count,
  sum(reused) as reused_count
FROM kv_samples
WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
GROUP BY session_id
ORDER BY evicted_count DESC
LIMIT 50
```

julia: Quick perf note — sampler-v3 reduced apparent long-session memory growth in load tests, but produced more of these "ghost evict" traces because it coalesces state transitions aggressively. We should keep both versions in metrics to compare.

omar: Plan: I'll add `kv_eviction_coalesced_total`, `kv_sample_version` tag, and a light residency_age histogram. Will also emit an opt-in per-session residency sampler for a few customers to correlate. Will push an RFC + PR today.

julia: Awesome — please ping infra when the staging deploy is up so we can run the soak. :eyes: 

omar: Will do. Thanks!
